description: Create the Audit Trail module infrastructure: seed data, storage helpers, AppContext integration, route, sidebar nav item, and the main AuditTrail page component with tab navigation for Activity Feed, Audit Log, User Sessions, and Change History tabs.
steps: Create src/data/seedAuditTrail.js with deterministic seed data using the seededRandom pattern from seedIntegrations.js. Generate: (a) activityFeed - 50+ activity entries with fields: id, timestamp, user, action (nurse.created, document.uploaded, placement.assigned, etc.), entityType (nurse/placement/document/cohort/communication), entityId, entityName, details object with before/after state, ipAddress (mock 192.168.x.x format). (b) auditLog - 80+ system event entries with fields: id, timestamp, user, action, entityType, entityId, ipAddress, details string, severity (info/warning/critical). (c) userSessions - 8-10 mock sessions with fields: id, userId, userName, role, loginTime, lastActivity, ipAddress, userAgent, status (active/idle/expired). (d) changeHistory - 30+ change records with fields: id, entityType, entityId, entityName, timestamp, user, changes array (each with field, oldValue, newValue), changeType (create/update/delete).

Add to src/lib/storage.js: import { seedAuditTrail } from '../data/seedAuditTrail'; Add getter/setter pairs: getActivityFeed/saveActivityFeed, getAuditLog/saveAuditLog, getUserSessions/saveUserSessions, getChangeHistory/saveChangeHistory. Add initialization block in initializeData() following the integrations pattern (check if activityFeed exists, if not seed all audit data).

Add to src/context/AppContext.jsx: import the new getter/setter functions, add state variables (activityFeed, auditLog, userSessions, changeHistory), add update callbacks (updateActivityFeed, updateAuditLog, updateUserSessions, updateChangeHistory), expose all in the context value object.

Create src/pages/AuditTrail.jsx with the same tab navigation pattern as Integrations.jsx. Tabs: Activity Feed (Activity icon), Audit Log (FileText icon), User Sessions (Users icon), Change History (History icon). Use placeholder content for each tab initially (simple div with tab name).
Add the /audit route in src/App.jsx importing AuditTrail page.
Add nav item in src/components/layout/Sidebar.jsx with path '/audit', label 'Audit Trail', and Shield icon from lucide-react. Place it after Integrations and before Settings in the nav order.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build succeeds with no errors
The /audit route is registered in App.jsx
Sidebar shows 'Audit Trail' nav item with Shield icon between Integrations and Settings
AuditTrail page renders with 4 working tab buttons
Seed data generates deterministic activity feed, audit log, user sessions, and change history entries
AppContext exposes activityFeed, auditLog, userSessions, changeHistory state and their update functions
